Adamant is maintained by one person plus agents; issues are triaged weekly.

State the JOB, not the solution. "I need to see which campaigns burned budget
with no leads" is a job; "add a Grafana integration" is a solution, and the
solution part is the maintainer's half of the conversation. Requests framed as
solutions tend to get translated back into jobs before anything happens anyway.
-->
